card.title: Will you add one small always-ready runner pool on workshop for the Sengi Run…
card.context: Ivo wants one small always-on runner on workshop, shared by every repo in the Sengi Runners GitHub org (where the Mezze app, zm, Potluck and Sengi are moving), so quick bookkeeping jobs start in seconds. Only you can change workshop's runner pools.
